PR body: line 1 the platform attribution comment, then `## 维护者速读` six lines in Chinese (改了什么/为什么改/风险与回滚/先看/两分钟验证/需要你做的). Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` on your diff, run each, record exits before any pipe, reconcile with `--ran`. Changeset in the root `.changeset/`. ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds. Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6442505640, verbatim: "`UIActionSchema.variant` spells danger `destructive`, while the spec's `ActionDef` says `danger`. The protocol is the baseline, so the ui types and renderers accept the spec's `danger`. Whether `destructive` is refused or kept as a reader-side alias is a narrowing of `@object-ui/types` (`Clause-②`), with an ADR-0087 entry if it is retired. The dev declares which." No maintainer ruling on A/B/C.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure)

- `ui/packages/types/src/ui-action.ts:883` reads `variant?: 'default' | 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'destructive' | 'outline' | 'ghost'` on `origin/main` `1685a06d`; the spec enum is at `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` (`'primary' | 'secondary' | 'danger' | 'ghost' | 'link'`). The four block renderers (`action:button`, `action:icon`, `action:group`, `action:menu`) do not forward `variant` to the runner; #26663 recorded four JUSTIFIED entries in `ui/scripts/check-action-forward-parity.mjs`.
- Who writes `destructive` on these blocks today is UNMEASURED (the card says so): count authored uses across `ui/**`, `examples/**`, `packages/**` fixtures and docs before choosing.

### PM suggested route (optional; measurement wins)

The card's seat recommendation is A (one spelling, the spec's; immediate retirement under the startup-stage rule, an ADR-0087 entry for the retired member), with the four JUSTIFIED entries removed once the renderers forward `variant`. Declare the choice and its reading in the body. A `danger` action declared through one of the four blocks must confirm through the destructive button (pin + ablation).

### Tier and review

No path-derived mandate. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `high`. `Clause-②: no` if the change only narrows (retires `destructive`), with `Metadata-protocol: narrowed`; if your route widens the accepted set, say `yes` in the report and stop for the seat. A narrowing owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` contract review before the queue (director seat); 「需要你做的」 says so.
